schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: THE GRAMMAR EVERY LEG OF THE CHART CHAIN SPEAKS. grammar.py: where things are (CAIRN_ROOT, INSTANCE_DIR), what exists (component_roster, ref_exists — the ONE semantics, so a judge and the gate that admitted a packet can never disagree), whose voyage (ticket_path, ticket_claim_error, identity_lack — the claim rides every link), and THE SHARED HALF OF EVERY STAGE'S PROOF RECORD: ``inspected`` mints one entry in the seed's shape (identity, location, code, expected, actual, fatality, source, values), ``common_shape_record`` returns the entries every packet owes whatever stage it is in, and ``lacks_of`` reads the mismatches back out. ``common_shape_lacks`` survives as a VIEW over ``lacks_of(common_shape_record(...))`` — DERIVED, NEVER PARALLEL, so the complaint list and the record cannot drift into disagreeing. render_lacks and CHAIN_REMEDY still shape the refusal sentence. chain.py: the leg vocabulary and the gate on ticket notes addressed to a leg.
why: EXTRACTED FROM ORIENT 2026-08-13, and the measurement is the argument: eight of the nine other legs imported orient, and NOT ONE touched floor_facts or validate_orient — every one took only the grammar. Stage 1 looked load-bearing for the whole chain and was not; the coupling was authorship order, not design. Left alone it made orient un-removable and made every other stage look like it needed orienting before it could check a field name. A TOOL, not a machine: it holds no durable state, so there is nothing to gate, so it has USERS and not an owner (Akien, 2026-08-13). The roster memo is a per-process memo of a measurement with an explicit forget_roster door, not a record.

feedback.why: A TOOL'S FINDINGS BELONG TO ITS USERS, AND HERE THE USERS HAVE EXACTLY ONE HOLDER. grammar's common_shape_record emits under the firing stage's own location ('cairn/devices/builder/machines/<stage>', grammar.py:257) — required_fields_present, list_fields_are_lists, provenance_covers_authored_fields and their kin. Every user of this grammar is a chart-chain machine, and all eight are held by cairn/devices/builder, so the static address is EXACT rather than a fallback: this is the difference between this route and learning_block's, whose callers are open-ended. Akien's rule for the -2- edge, 2026-08-14, verbatim: "the purpose of an inspector/gate combination is to qa THE OUTPUT OF THE THING BEFORE IT THATS COMING IN AS ITS INPUT. IF IT FAILS, GENERALLY THAT FEEDBACK GOES BACK TO THE UPSTREAM CREATIVE ENTITY. In some cases it skips levels." REFINED BY HIM THE SAME DAY, and the refinement is what `to` MEANS: "really it shouldn't be 'number of steps' it should be 'to the feedback target' which is likely to be the previous step." So this field is not a hop count and never was — it names the TARGET. The previous step is the common case, not the definition, and a route that lands elsewhere is not a special case needing a count. And the builder is the right party rather than merely the reachable one — a shape failure appearing across several stages at once is a fact about the CHAIN, invisible from inside any one leg, and the builder is the only address that owns the eight-step method the chain implements.

invoke: imported by every chart-chain machine; `python3 -m cairn.tools.chain.chain` scans live tickets for nonconforming notes
entry: Carved out of the chart machine on 2026-08-13 under Akien's ruling — "chart is a skill, it calls a collection of machines. that's the intention." The chart charter it was carved from is the design record of the whole chain and now berths with the skill at cairn/skills/chart/intention+why.json; this file holds only what is THIS component's. Grew the proof-record half on 2026-08-13 under the ruling every-machine-carries-its-own-inspector-and-gate: the eight stages needed one shape for "what did this check EXPECT and what did it ACTUALLY see", and the shape is Akien's 2007 seed, held at cairn/machines/diagnostic_inspector. It berths here for the same measured reason the grammar did: every stage needs it and no stage owns it.
state_and_history: state.json + history.json beside this charter, BORN AT THIS ADDRESS'S FIRST CROSSING. Until a ticket crosses here there is no journal, and that absence is this component's ordinary resting state rather than a missing file — a component that has never sailed has no voyage to record. CORRECTED 2026-08-20 (ticket a-charter-may-not-assert-a-file-that-is-not-there).
gates: validate_chart_notes refuses a note addressed to a non-leg; the leg vocabulary (STAGES) has one home and this is it (Law 6). AND `bin/cmd/determinism` MARKS THIS TOOL A GATE, and is RIGHT TO: gate-ness there is a DIRECT-IMPORT fact, deliberately coarser than "takes the verdict", precisely so a component cannot hide its gate behind a helper. This tool imports cairn/tools/gate to mint entries; it does not take the artifact-level verdict — each of the eight stages does that at its own address. Both sentences are true and the instrument is not to be softened to make the second one prettier.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a second implementation of ref resolution or ticket-path lookup anywhere in the chain — two mouths that can disagree is the defect this file exists to remove; (2) this tool importing any machine (a rung inversion; it happened once, when tree.py held orient's deposit, and the move exposed it); (3) the roster memo outliving a real install in a long-lived holder without forget_roster firing — named as an IOU, not a resting state. The dial was placed here at the carve-out and moved straight back out: it imports all seven stage machines to read their AUTHORED_FIELDS, so a tool holding it would be a rung inversion seven times over. It belongs to the caller, and it now sits beside the skill's edge. AND RED if ``common_shape_lacks`` ever grows an implementation of its own rather than reading ``common_shape_record`` — two mouths for one question is the drift this seam exists to prevent; and RED if anything here consults an oracle, at fire time or at sleep.
horizon: re-read when a FileChanged hook can fire forget_roster, which is the physics that retires the memo's residue.
how_it_learns: it doesn't, and that is the point: this is the fixed vocabulary the learning stages are written in. What learns are the nexi that speak it. The dial is how anyone reads whether that learning is actually compiling.
traces_to: Law 6 (one owner of the leg vocabulary)
owner: CC owns the code and proofs. A tool has users, not an owner — every chart-chain machine is a user.
proof: proofs/test_chart_notes.py, sealed by the tester; validations/ beside. The grammar itself is proved by all seven stage proofs, which cannot pass without it.
